text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a gain felt satisfying, but I should base future decisions on its prospects and portfolio fit—not on my purchase price or the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I made no trades in most periods, which is a useful reminder that I need not react to every price move, especially when past changes do not predict future ones.","Before trading, I should check whether my holdings remain appropriately diversified and suited to my risk needs rather than letting reluctance to realize a loss dictate what I keep."]}
